what: Clicking a link to another page on the same site brings four color panels (gold, ochre, teal, base) up from 118% below the screen, tilted −8·6·−4·2°, at .07s intervals over .78s ”deal” (0.16,1,0.3,1), stacking straight into a card pile, at .52s the card-back pattern on the top panel opens from the bottom (clip inset 100%→0 · 14% below → 0, .7s) and navigation happens at .86s. On the arriving page the pattern slides up 18% in .4s ”sweep” (0.76,0,0.24,1), and from .05s the panels tilt .6x opposite to the first tilt and clear upward to −118%, top panel first at .06s intervals over .62s — fx:reveal is sent at .32s.

options.tilts: Initial tilt per panel (deg), comma-separated, default -8, 6, -4, 2
options.go: Flip timing (sec), default .86 — lower it to flip faster
options.out: Seconds for the panel to clear after arrival, default .62
options.[data-fx-part=mark]: Card-back pattern to open at the center of the top panel (optional)
options.[data-deal-skip]: Links inside this go through with no curtain
options.fx:reveal: Signal sent to the window at .32s of reveal on the arrived page (immediately if opened without a transition) — hook the hero intro here

use: Pattern

from.where: shared.js transition curtain (.tt-deal) — original PageTransition: four panels [-8,6,-4,2]° · yPercent 118 · .78 ttDeal stagger .07 · pattern inset/14% .7 @.52 · push @.86 · walking pattern -18% .4 ttSweep, panels -118% · -(.6×tilt) .62 ttSweep each .06 from end @.05 · hero:reveal @.32

note: The original switches pages with the Next router, but the part navigates normally and the destination page lifts the curtain using a sessionStorage flag. When returning via back (bfcache), the curtain is removed
